rules.name: Domain Layer Independence
rules.description: Domain layer must not import Presentation or Data layers
rules.message: Domain layer must not depend on Presentation or Data layers

rules.name: Presentation No Data Import
rules.description: Presentation layer should not directly import Data layer
rules.message: Presentation layer should access data through Domain layer, not directly

rules.name: Data No Presentation Import
rules.description: Data layer must not import Presentation layer
rules.message: Data layer must not depend on Presentation layer

rules.name: SwiftUI in Presentation Only
rules.description: SwiftUI should only be used in Presentation layer
rules.message: SwiftUI should only be imported in Presentation layer

rules.name: No UIKit Usage
rules.description: Prefer SwiftUI over UIKit in new code
rules.message: Consider using SwiftUI instead of UIKit for new code
